name: BeamDrop
highlights: ⚡ Direct Phone Download Gateway: Scanning QR immediately prompts native browser download without opening website UI
🔄 1-Click Fast Extension Updater: Automatic notification badge in Chrome toolbar & 1-click in-place reload
🔔 Background Cloud Watcher: Periodically checks GitHub / Vercel for new releases automatically
📦 Backpressure Flow Control: Zero-loss RAM buffer control for streaming large 4K video files and ZIP archives

changelog.title: 1-Click Fast Updater & Background Notification Engine
changes: In-extension 1-click fast updater: update directly without removing or re-adding the extension in Chrome
Toolbar notification badge ('NEW') when a new GitHub/Vercel release is published
Periodic background watcher to alert users automatically of new releases
Interactive test switcher to simulate and test updates from v1.0.0, v1.1.0, v1.2.0 to v1.3.0

changelog.title: Direct Download Gateway & Isolated Download Portal
changes: Direct Phone Download: Scanning QR immediately prompts native browser download for that specific file
Dedicated isolated download window with zero website distraction
Direct stream progress bar with live MB/s and instant auto-download trigger

changelog.title: Staging Area & Flow Control
changes: Multi-file staging container before generating QR code
64KB chunk backpressure control to prevent buffer saturation
Offline pure CSS styling & strict 380px sizing

changelog.title: Initial Manifest V3 Launch
changes: Zero cloud storage and zero database
